  FROM target_dictionary
  WHERE pref_name = 'Sialic acid‑binding Ig‑like lectin 9'
    AND tax_id = 9606
    AND organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND target_type = 'PROTEIN'
),
assays_hs AS (
  SELECT a.assay_id
  FROM assays a
  JOIN target ON a.tid = target.tid
  WHERE target.tid = target.tid
),
compound_records_hs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cr.molregno, cr.chembl_id
  FROM compound_records cr
  JOIN assay_records ar ON cr.record_id = ar.record_id
  JOIN assays a ON ar.assay_id = a.assay_id
  JOIN target ON a.tid = target.tid
  WHERE target.tid = target.tid
    AND target.pref_name = 'Sialic acid‑binding Ig‑like lectin 9'
    AND target.tax_id = 9606
    AND target.organism = 'Homo sapiens'

FROM molecule_dictionary
JOIN compound_records ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
JOIN compound_records_hs ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records_hs.molregno
WHERE molecule_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4105860';
